Package be.stef.rar4.decompress

Class Lz77Decompressor

java.lang.Object
be.stef.rar4.decompress.Lz77Decompressor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rar4Decompressor
public class Lz77Decompressor extends Object implements Rar4Decompressor
LZ77 decompressor for RAR4 archives (algorithm version 2.9 / 3.x), including support for the standard post-processing filters (E8, E8E9, DELTA) via signature recognition - bypassing full VM bytecode interpretation.
Since:
1.0
Author:
Stef
